name: google_search
description: Google web search (organic results). Returns one flat array per field across organic results; consumers zip them by index. ROW-ALIGNMENT INVARIANT: every field must match exactly one node per result, so all four scope to #rso div.tF2Cxc — the organic-result container Google renders for EVERY result (div.g was retired) — which also keeps ads/PAA/nav blocks out. `snippets` anchors to div.tF2Cxc itself (not to div[data-sncf='1'], which exists ONLY when the result has a snippet) and digs the text out of that container's html by regex: a snippet-less result then yields null in its own slot instead of shrinking the array and silently shifting every later row up one. Never point a field at an element that only exists when its value does. Routes to country-specific domain (google.de, google.co.uk, ...) matching the locale's market country (gl=/hl=). The proxy exit follows `proxy_country` where set, not the market: the `us` locale exits via GB because Google blocks this proxy pool's US residential range. Materializer must lowercase `country` for gl= and derive a language code for hl= from the locale.
